whoItsFor: Developers who use AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or Gemini CLI and want to monitor sessions and approve permissions without leaving their work. It is also for people who want to chat with several AI providers from the Mac notch or a phone.
useCases: Approve or deny Claude Code permission requests and answer its questions from the notch or iPhone Lock Screen
Watch live agent sessions, including files edited and commands run, and jump to the right terminal
Chat with Claude, OpenAI, Gemini or a local Ollama or LM Studio model from the notch

requirements.os: macOS 15+ (Windows 10/11, Linux, iOS 18+ and Android 11+ companion apps also listed)
